AppLock.title: App lock
AppLock.description: Keep Think Bee private on this browser. It locks when you reopen it, move it to the background or leave it idle for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
AppLock.deviceOnly: This lock stays on this browser. Keep your device’s screen lock on too.
AppLock.unsupported: App lock needs a secure connection and an up-to-date browser. Try the latest Chrome, Safari or Firefox.
AppLock.deviceBody: Use your device’s fingerprint, face or screen lock. Your PIN will still work.
AppLock.deviceEnabled: Device unlock is on. You can also use your PIN.
AppLock.deviceUnavailable: Device unlock is not available in this browser. You can use your PIN.
AppLock.lockedBody: Enter your PIN to pick up where you left off.
AppLock.storageBody: We could not read this browser’s lock settings. Your app stays hidden. Allow browser storage, then try again.
AppLock.pinMismatch: Enter the same PIN in both fields.
AppLock.choosePin: Choose a {digits}-digit PIN you can remember. Keep it to yourself.
AppLock.confirmCurrent: Enter your current PIN to confirm this change.
AppLock.offline: You’re offline. Your PIN still works.
AppLock.retryIn: Try your PIN again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
AppLock.recoveryBody: This signs you out and removes your local drafts and saved account details from this browser. Anything not yet synced will be lost. Your account and information already synced are kept. You’ll need to sign in again.
AppLock.recoveryOffline: Connect to the internet to reset the lock and sign out.
AppLock.resetDevice: Clear local data and sign out

Scan.title: Scan for Early Signs
Scan.body: Use AI photo guidance to spot possible problems with your bees and crops.
Scan.hiveHint: Look for signs of disease or stress in frames, brood, and comb.
Scan.cropHint: Look for signs of pests, nutrient problems, or disease on leaves, stems, and fruit.
Scan.notice: A scan gives likely causes, not a confirmed diagnosis.
Scan.searchEmpty: No photo-check topic matched “{query}”. Try hive, crop, or pests.
Scan.addPhotoToStart: Add a photo to get started.
Scan.cropNotePlaceholder: e.g. Yellow spots appeared on the lower leaves after rain…

Scan.disclaimer: AI analysis provides guidance, not a diagnosis. Always verify with local experts.
Scan.disclaimerFull: This analysis is AI-generated guidance for educational purposes. It is not a professional diagnosis. Always follow product labels and consult local agricultural extension services or veterinarians for confirmed treatment.
Scan.chatWithAi: Chat with AI about this scan

account.title: A private sign-in
account.body: Supabase manages your email sign-in and session. Your email is used for authentication and is never shown to other farmers.

profile.title: You choose what others see
profile.body: Your display name and bio form your chat profile. Your general area, crops and hive details stay hidden unless you choose to share them.

farms.title: Private farm details
farms.body: Your farm names and locations belong to your account. We do not ask for GPS during setup. Exact coordinates are never shown to other users.

device.title: Drafts on this device
device.body: Profile and farm drafts are saved in this browser before syncing. Signing out clears those local drafts. Use your own browser profile on a shared device.

chat.title: Conversations and advice
chat.body: Messages are not end-to-end encrypted in this version. The review team can review reported messages. Advice from farmers and AI does not replace an expert assessment.

control.title: Your choices
control.body: You can correct your profile and farm details and request account deletion. Nothing is recorded as done until you confirm it. The full privacy and retention notice will be reviewed before the public pilot.
